name: College Event - Coordinator Report
query: SELECT event_coordinator as "Coordinator:Link/Employee:150", COUNT(name) as "Events Coordinated:Int:120", SUM(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Completed:Int:100" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE event_coordinator IS NOT NULL AND event_coordinator != '' GROUP BY event_coordinator ORDER BY `Events Coordinated` DESC

name: College Event - Winner Report
query: SELECT ew.event as "Event:Link/College Event:200", ew.student as "Student:Link/Admission Student:150", ew.rank as "Rank:Data:100", ew.prize as "Prize:Data:150", ew.cash_prize as "Cash Prize:Currency:100", ew.certificate_issued as "Certificate Issued:Check:100" FROM `tabEvent Winner` ew ORDER BY ew.modified DESC

name: College Event - Budget Report
query: SELECT name as "Event:Link/College Event:150", event_name as "Event Name:Data:200", budget as "Budget:Currency:100", actual_expense as "Actual Expense:Currency:120", (budget - actual_expense) as "Variance:Currency:100" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE budget IS NOT NULL AND budget > 0 ORDER BY starts_on DESC

name: College Event - Certificate Report
query: SELECT name as "Certificate No:Link/Event Certificate:150", event as "Event:Link/College Event:200", student as "Student:Link/Admission Student:150", issue_date as "Issue Date:Date:100", status as "Status:Data:100" FROM `tabEvent Certificate` ORDER BY issue_date DESC

name: College Event - Attendance Report
query: SELECT ea.student as "Student:Link/Admission Student:150", ce.event_name as "Event:Link/College Event:200", ea.attendance as "Attendance:Data:100", ea.late_entry as "Late Entry:Check:80", ea.certificate_issued as "Certificate Issued:Check:100" FROM `tabEvent Attendance` ea INNER JOIN `tabCollege Event` ce ON ce.name = ea.parent ORDER BY ce.event_name

name: College Event - Student Participation Report
query: SELECT er.student as "Student:Link/Admission Student:150", ce.event_name as "Event:Link/College Event:200", ce.event_category as "Category:Data:120", er.registration_date as "Registered On:Date:100", er.status as "Status:Data:100" FROM `tabEvent Registration` er INNER JOIN `tabCollege Event` ce ON ce.name = er.parent ORDER BY er.registration_date DESC

name: College Event - Club-wise Events
query: SELECT club as "Club:Link/Student Club:150", COUNT(name) as "Total Events:Int:100", SUM(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Completed:Int:100", SUM(current_participants) as "Total Participants:Int:120" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE event_status = 'Completed' AND club IS NOT NULL AND club != '' GROUP BY club ORDER BY `Total Events` DESC

name: College Event - Department-wise Events
query: SELECT department as "Department:Link/Department:150", COUNT(name) as "Total Events:Int:100", SUM(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Completed:Int:100", SUM(current_participants) as "Total Participants:Int:120" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE department IS NOT NULL AND department != '' GROUP BY department ORDER BY `Total Events` DESC

name: College Event - Completed Events
query: SELECT name as "Event:Link/College Event:150", event_name as "Event Name:Data:200", event_category as "Category:Data:120", starts_on as "Starts On:Datetime:150", current_participants as "Participants:Int:100", actual_expense as "Actual Expense:Currency:120" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE event_status = 'Completed' ORDER BY starts_on DESC

name: College Event - Upcoming Events
query: SELECT name as "Event:Link/College Event:150", event_name as "Event Name:Data:200", event_category as "Category:Data:120", starts_on as "Starts On:Datetime:150", venue as "Venue:Data:120", registration_status as "Registration:Data:100" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE event_status IN ('Upcoming','Ongoing') ORDER BY starts_on ASC

name: Academic Calendar - Calendar Report
query: SELECT name as "Calendar:Link/Academic Calendar:150", academic_year as "Academic Year:Link/Academic Year:100" FROM `tabAcademic Calendar` ORDER BY creation DESC

name: Academic Calendar - Overdue Activities
query: SELECT name as "Event ID:Data:120", start_date as "Start Date:Date:100", DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), start_date) as "Days Overdue:Int:100" FROM `tabAcademic Calendar Event` WHERE start_date < CURDATE() ORDER BY start_date ASC

name: Academic Calendar - Upcoming Activities
query: SELECT name as "Event ID:Data:120", start_date as "Start Date:Date:100", DATEDIFF(start_date, CURDATE()) as "Days Away:Int:100" FROM `tabAcademic Calendar Event` WHERE start_date > CURDATE() ORDER BY start_date ASC

name: Academic Calendar - Event Status Overview
query: SELECT name as "Event ID:Data:120", start_date as "Start Date:Date:100", end_date as "End Date:Date:100", CASE WHEN start_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Overdue' WHEN start_date = CURDATE() THEN 'Today' WHEN start_date > CURDATE() THEN 'Upcoming' ELSE 'Scheduled' END as "Status:Data:100" FROM `tabAcademic Calendar Event` ORDER BY start_date ASC

name: Placement Pending Offers
query: SELECT po.name as "Offer:Link/Placement Offer:120", ast.student_name as "Student:Data:150", po.company as "Company:Link/Placement Company:150", po.package_lpa as "Package:Currency:100", po.offer_date as "Offer Date:Date:100" FROM `tabPlacement Offer` po LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Registration` pr ON po.registration = pr.name LEFT JOIN `tabAdmission Student` ast ON ast.name = pr.admission_student ORDER BY po.offer_date ASC

name: Placement Drive Eligibility Summary
query: SELECT pd.drive_title as "Drive:Link/Placement Drive:150", pd.company as "Company:Link/Placement Company:150", COUNT(pr.name) as "Total Applications:Int:120", SUM(CASE WHEN pr.eligible=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Eligible:Int:80", SUM(CASE WHEN pr.eligible=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Not Eligible:Int:100" FROM `tabPlacement Drive` pd LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Registration` pr ON pr.placement_drive = pd.name GROUP BY pd.name ORDER BY pd.drive_date DESC

name: Placement Company-wise Summary
query: SELECT pc.company_name as "Company:Data:150", COUNT(DISTINCT pd.name) as "Drives Conducted:Int:100", COUNT(DISTINCT po.name) as "Offers Made:Int:100", ROUND(AVG(po.package_lpa),2) as "Average Package:Currency:120", MAX(po.package_lpa) as "Highest Package:Currency:120" FROM `tabPlacement Company` pc LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Drive` pd ON pd.company = pc.name LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Offer` po ON po.company = pc.name GROUP BY pc.name ORDER BY `Offers Made` DESC

name: Placement Selected Students
query: SELECT ast.student_name as "Student:Data:150", pr.program as "Program:Link/Program:120", pd.drive_title as "Drive:Link/Placement Drive:150", pd.company as "Company:Link/Placement Company:150", po.package_lpa as "Package (LPA):Currency:100", po.role as "Role:Data:150", po.offer_date as "Offer Date:Date:100" FROM `tabPlacement Registration` pr LEFT JOIN `tabAdmission Student` ast ON ast.name = pr.admission_student LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Drive` pd ON pr.placement_drive = pd.name LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Offer` po ON po.registration = pr.name WHERE pr.eligible = 1 ORDER BY po.offer_date DESC

name: Placement Application Summary
query: SELECT pr.name as "Registration:Link/Placement Registration:150", ast.student_name as "Student:Data:150", pr.program as "Program:Link/Program:120", pd.drive_title as "Drive:Link/Placement Drive:150", pd.company as "Company:Link/Placement Company:150", pr.percentage_cumulative_published as "Percentage:Percent:100", pr.current_backlogs as "Backlogs:Int:80", CASE WHEN pr.eligible = 1 THEN 'Eligible' ELSE 'Not Eligible' END as "Status:Data:120", pr.applied_on as "Applied On:Date:100" FROM `tabPlacement Registration` pr LEFT JOIN `tabAdmission Student` ast ON ast.name = pr.admission_student LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Drive` pd ON pr.placement_drive = pd.name ORDER BY pr.applied_on DESC

name: Scholarship Disbursement by Scheme
query: SELECT sch.name as "Scheme:Link/Scholarship Scheme:180", sch.academic_year as "Academic Year:Link/Academic Year:100", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabScholarship Application` sa WHERE sa.scheme = sch.name) as "Applications:Int:100", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ss.sanction_amount),0) FROM `tabScholarship Sanction` ss INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Application` sa2 ON sa2.name = ss.application WHERE sa2.scheme = sch.name) as "Total Sanctioned:Currency:140", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sp.amount),0) FROM `tabScholarship Payment` sp INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Sanction` ss2 ON ss2.name = sp.sanction INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Application` sa3 ON sa3.name = ss2.application WHERE sa3.scheme = sch.name ) as "Total Paid:Currency:140", ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ss3.sanction_amount),0) FROM `tabScholarship Sanction` ss3 INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Application` sa4 ON sa4.name = ss3.application WHERE sa4.scheme = sch.name) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sp2.amount),0) FROM `tabScholarship Payment` sp2 INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Sanction` ss4 ON ss4.name = sp2.sanction INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Application` sa5 ON sa5.name = ss4.application WHERE sa5.scheme = sch.name )) as "Pending Disbursement:Currency:140" FROM `tabScholarship Scheme` sch ORDER BY sch.creation DESC

name: Revaluation - Pending Applications
query: SELECT name as "Application:Link/Revaluation Application:150", student_name as "Student:Data:150", revaluation_type as "Type:Data:100", total_fee as "Total Fee:Currency:100", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabRevaluation Application Item` ri WHERE ri.parent = ra.name) as "Subjects:Int:80", creation as "Submitted On:Datetime:140", status as "Status:Data:100" FROM `tabRevaluation Application` ra WHERE ra.status = 'Pending' ORDER BY application_date ASC

name: Revaluation - Fee Summary
query: SELECT revaluation_type as "Type:Data:120", COUNT(name) as "Applications:Int:100", SUM(total_fee) as "Total Fee Collected:Currency:140" FROM `tabRevaluation Application` WHERE docstatus = 1 GROUP BY revaluation_type ORDER BY `Applications` DESC

name: Feedback - Survey Responses
query: SELECT sr.name as "Response:Link/Feedback Survey Response:120", sr.survey as "Survey:Link/Feedback Survey:150", sr.respondent_type as "Type:Data:80", sr.submitted_on as "Submitted:Datetime:140", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabFeedback Response Answer` ra WHERE ra.parent = sr.name) as "Questions Answered:Int:120" FROM `tabFeedback Survey Response` sr ORDER BY sr.submitted_on DESC

name: Feedback - Survey Completion Rate
query: SELECT fs.name as "Survey:Link/Feedback Survey:150", fs.survey_title as "Title:Data:200", fs.survey_type as "Category:Data:100", fs.status as "Status:Data:100", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabFeedback Survey Response` sr WHERE sr.survey = fs.name) as "Responses:Int:100", COALESCE(fs.total_responses, 0) as "Target:Int:80", ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabFeedback Survey Response` sr WHERE sr.survey = fs.name) * 100.0 / CASE WHEN fs.total_responses = 0 THEN NULL ELSE fs.total_responses END, 1) as "Completion %:Percent:80" FROM `tabFeedback Survey` fs ORDER BY fs.creation DESC

name: Question Bank - Questions by Subject
query: SELECT qb.name as "Bank:Link/Question Bank:150", qb.subject as "Subject:Link/Course:150", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabQuestion Bank Item` qi WHERE qi.parent = qb.name) as "Total Questions:Int:100", (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN qi.difficulty = 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM `tabQuestion Bank Item` qi WHERE qi.parent = qb.name) as "Low:Int:60", (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN qi.difficulty = 'Medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM `tabQuestion Bank Item` qi WHERE qi.parent = qb.name) as "Medium:Int:60", (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN qi.difficulty = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM `tabQuestion Bank Item` qi WHERE qi.parent = qb.name) as "High:Int:60" FROM `tabQuestion Bank` qb ORDER BY `Total Questions` DESC

name: Question Bank - Generated Papers
query: SELECT qpt.name as "Template:Link/Question Paper Template:150", qpt.title as "Title:Data:200", qpt.subject as "Subject:Link/Course:150", qpt.question_bank as "Bank:Link/Question Bank:120", qpt.total_marks as "Total Marks:Int:80", CASE WHEN qpt.generated_on IS NOT NULL THEN 'Generated' ELSE 'Draft' END as "Status:Data:80", qpt.generated_on as "Last Generated:Datetime:150" FROM `tabQuestion Paper Template` qpt ORDER BY qpt.modified DESC

name: Assignments - Submission Status
query: SELECT a.name as "Assignment:Link/Assignment:120", a.title as "Title:Data:200", a.course as "Course:Link/Course:120", a.due_date as "Due Date:Date:100", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabAssignment Submission` ass WHERE ass.assignment = a.name) as "Submissions:Int:80", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabAssignment Submission` ass WHERE ass.assignment = a.name AND ass.status = 'Graded') as "Graded:Int:80" FROM `tabAssignment` a ORDER BY a.due_date DESC

name: Assignments - Student Performance
query: SELECT ass.name as "Submission:Link/Assignment Submission:120", ass.student_name as "Student:Data:150", a.title as "Assignment:Data:200", ass.submitted_on as "Submitted:Date:100", ass.status as "Status:Data:100", ass.marks_obtained as "Score:Int:60", a.max_marks as "Max Marks:Int:60" FROM `tabAssignment Submission` ass LEFT JOIN `tabAssignment` a ON ass.assignment = a.name ORDER BY ass.submitted_on DESC

name: Student Certificates - Issuance Log
query: SELECT name as "Request:Link/Student Certificate Request:120", student_name as "Student:Data:150", 'Student' as "Type:Data:120", request_date as "Request Date:Date:100", status as "Status:Data:100", issue_date as "Issued On:Date:100" FROM `tabStudent Certificate Request` ORDER BY request_date DESC

name: Grievance - Pending Cases
query: SELECT name as "Grievance:Link/Grievance:120", subject as "Subject:Data:200", student as "Student:Link/Admission Student:120", grievance_type as "Type:Data:100", urgency as "Urgency:Data:80", status as "Status:Data:100", creation as "Opened On:Datetime:140" FROM `tabGrievance` WHERE status IN ('Open','In Progress') ORDER BY CASE urgency WHEN 'Critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, creation ASC

name: Library - Books by Category
query: SELECT IFNULL(category,'Uncategorized') as "Category:Data:150", COUNT(name) as "Total Books:Int:100", SUM(quantity) as "Total Copies:Int:100", SUM(available_copies) as "Available Copies:Int:100", (SUM(quantity) - SUM(available_copies)) as "Issued Copies:Int:100" FROM `tabLibrary Book` GROUP BY category ORDER BY `Total Books` DESC

name: Library - Overdue Books
query: SELECT lt.name as "Transaction:Link/Library Transaction:120", lt.member as "Member:Link/Library Member:150", lt.transaction_date as "Issued On:Date:100", lt.status as "Status:Data:100"FROM `tabLibrary Transaction` lt WHERE lt.docstatus = 1 AND lt.transaction_type = 'Issue' AND lt.status = 'Issued' ORDER BY lt.transaction_date ASC

name: Hostel - Occupancy Report
query: SELECT h.name as "Hostel:Link/Hostel:120", h.hostel_name as "Name:Data:150", h.total_capacity as "Capacity:Int:80", h.current_occupancy as "Occupied:Int:80", (h.total_capacity - h.current_occupancy) as "Available:Int:80", ROUND(h.current_occupancy * 100.0 / CASE WHEN h.total_capacity = 0 THEN NULL ELSE h.total_capacity END, 1) as "Occupancy %:Percent:80", h.hostel_type as "Type:Data:100" FROM `tabHostel` h ORDER BY `Occupancy %` DESC

name: Transport - Allocations by Route
query: SELECT ta.route as "Route:Link/Transport Route:150", COUNT(ta.name) as "Students:Int:100", tv.vehicle_number as "Vehicle:Data:120" FROM `tabTransport Allocation` ta LEFT JOIN `tabTransport Vehicle` tv ON tv.name = ta.vehicle WHERE ta.status = 'Active' GROUP BY ta.route ORDER BY `Students` DESC

name: OMR - Grading Results
query: SELECT oas.name as "Sheet:Link/OMR Answer Sheet:120", oas.answer_key as "Key:Link/OMR Answer Key:120", oas.student_name as "Student:Data:150", oas.total_questions as "Total:Int:60", oas.correct_count as "Correct:Int:60", oas.wrong_count as "Wrong:Int:60", oas.score as "Score:Float:80", CASE WHEN oas.passed = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as "Passed:Data:60", oas.graded_on as "Graded On:Datetime:140" FROM `tabOMR Answer Sheet` oas ORDER BY oas.graded_on DESC

name: Convocation - Registration Summary
query: SELECT c.name as "Convocation:Link/Convocation:120", c.title as "Title:Data:200", c.convocation_date as "Date:Date:100", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabConvocation Registration` cr WHERE cr.convocation = c.name) as "Registrations:Int:100", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabConvocation Registration` cr WHERE cr.convocation = c.name AND cr.certificate_collected = 1) as "Attended:Int:80" FROM `tabConvocation` c ORDER BY c.convocation_date DESC

name: Accreditation - Scores Summary
query: SELECT ar.name as "Report:Link/Accreditation Report:120", ar.title as "Title:Data:200", ar.accreditation_body as "Body:Data:120", ar.academic_year as "Year:Data:80", ar.overall_score as "Total Score:Float:80", 0 as "Max Score:Float:80", ROUND(ar.overall_score * 100.0 / NULLIF(100, 0), 1) as "Percentage:Percent:80", ar.overall_grade as "Grade:Data:60" FROM `tabAccreditation Report` ar ORDER BY ar.creation DESC

name: Auto Grading - Quiz Results
query: SELECT agr.name as "Result:Link/Auto Grade Result:120", agr.quiz as "Quiz:Link/LMS Quiz:150", agr.student as "Student:Link/User:120", agr.score as "Score %:Percent:80", agr.correct_answers as "Correct:Int:60", agr.wrong_answers as "Wrong:Int:60", agr.total_questions as "Total:Int:60", agr.grading_method as "Method:Data:100", agr.creation as "Graded On:Datetime:140" FROM `tabAuto Grade Result` agr ORDER BY agr.creation DESC
